info.What it is: One app for small businesses: each business picks the apps it needs. The app (Flutter) talks to Frappe servers; every product is a Frappe app on top of the shared Platform.
info.How a tap reaches the data: Screen (qtt_app/lib/…) → repository method → endpoint (@frappe.whitelist in an api/ file) → Python rules (*_rules.py, tested without a server) → data table (DocType)

info.What it is: Every business — sign-in, Home, Team, Files, Calendar, Customers

info.About: What people see in the app (and where the assistant can take them). Code: qtt-os/qtt_app/lib/platform

info.What it shows: Your accounts (switch between several), appearance, language, tips, help and support, fingerprint / Face ID sign-in, sign out.
Light, dark or system mode, theme, text size and density.
Logo, address, GSTIN, contact details, bank and UPI — used on invoices, payslips and PDFs. Only the owner or an admin can change them.

Invite teammates by email with an app and a role (they get an email with a Join button and a short code like K7M2-QX9P, valid 7 days, once); pending invitations show their code — copy a WhatsApp-ready message with the link and code, or revoke; choose which apps each person can use and their role in each app; remove people.

A table for each of your apps: what each role can do. In Orbitra, tap a cell to let a Manager or Cashier use an area or not (the Orbitra Admin always has everything; Settings stays the admin's); Reset puts a role back to the usual. The other apps' roles are fixed. Changes apply at once.
Each app's plan and trial end date, your invoices with Pay now, and Explore QTT OS to start another app or service. To change an app's plan, contact Queen Touch Technology.

One place for what your business knows: what you do, hours, holidays, delivery, payments, bookings, policies, your products and services with prices, questions and answers (each for customers, your team only, or everyone) and notes for your team (for everyone or some roles). Your WhatsApp receptionist answers customers from it (never team-only ones), the Marketing assistant writes posts and articles from it, and your team's Know your business answers staff from it. The brand kit — your main, second, accent, dark and light colours and two fonts — is what every post uses, with your logo from Profile; they never change. Type of business picks the photos and post designs that suit you; See your brand shows your brand kit as one picture. The bar at the top shows how complete it is and what to add next. Test lab: try it as a customer (your WhatsApp receptionist's own answer if you have one), as your team (pick a role), or get this week's post ideas — nothing is sent. Your team's questions: what your team asked Know your business that it couldn't answer — add the answer (for the team, customers or everyone) or dismiss it. Owner or admin.

Ask how things work in your business — products and prices, hours, delivery, policies, how things are done here. It answers only from your business's own knowledge (Business › Knowledge, written by the owner): what customers are told, the questions and answers for the team, and the team notes for your role. Pay, payslips, bank details and anyone's personal details are never answered — ask HR or the owner. If it doesn't know, it says so, and the owner sees the question so they can add it. You can also ask on WhatsApp: message QTT's WhatsApp number from the phone number on your account or employee record (when your owner allows it).

The one Calendar for everyone (Home › the calendar button with today's date, or Up next on Home): meetings, posts going out (social, Google, articles, newsletters, each series' next post), renewals and expiries (domains, security certificates, previews — owners and admins), leave, holidays and birthdays (Office Pulse) — each person sees what their role lets them. Views: Schedule, Day, 3 days, Week, Month (the menu at the top right); swipe sideways for earlier or later; the chips turn layers on or off; a red line is the time now. Tap a meeting to open it; anything else shows its details and Open (the screen it belongs to). New event comes with Office Pulse's team calendar.
One customer list shared by every app (Inbox chats, Orbitra bills). Add, tag, archive; call, WhatsApp or email a customer. With Orbitra it is opened from Orbitra › Customers (no separate menu item).
Add an individual or a business (GSTIN, billing address, tags).

info.Where in the app: Home › Explore QTT OS (also Business › Plans and billing)
info.What it shows: All of QTT OS in one place: the apps (Orbitra, Office Pulse) and the managed services (Website Development, Managed E-Commerce Websites, AI & WhatsApp Automation, Marketing assistant), each with what it does and its three plans. The owner starts an app's free trial (once per app) or chooses a plan; a paid plan starts as soon as its first invoice is paid (Pay now). A service opens its order page.
Your apps, the For you cards (what needs you now) and search across everything.
The four QTT products — Office Pulse, Orbitra, QTT Studio and QTT Business Suite — each with what it does, and Help me choose.
What one product does, its real screen and what you get; start its free trial, see plans, or order a QTT Business Suite service.

Three steps: your goals, the products recommended for them, what to include — then a summary and Launch. Apps start their free trial; each QTT Business Suite service finishes on its own page (address, design, details).
One search for customers, people, items and apps. Understands typos, any word order and phone numbers.

Your business's own chat, free with QTT OS. At the top: you (tap to set a status like 📅 In a meeting, cleared after a time, or Do not disturb), who's online now, and the hub — Activity (mentions, replies and reactions for you), Threads, Saved, Tasks. Then #general (everyone), channels (open or private, 🔕 when muted, @ when someone mentioned you) and direct messages with each person's presence (green online, amber away) and status. New message: a person or a new channel. On a wide screen the chat opens beside the list.

One chat: write with *bold* _italic_ ~strike~ `code` (the Aa button), @Name to mention someone (they get a notification even if they muted the chat), @everyone in a channel. ⊕ sends a photo or file (up to 25 MB), the mic records a voice note (up to 5 minutes). Hover (computer) or long-press (phone) a message: react, Reply in thread, Quote in reply, Copy, Edit or Delete your own, Pin to chat, Save for later (with a reminder), Make a task. Under your latest message: Sent / Seen / Seen by N. '… is typing' shows live. ✨ Catch me up sums up the chat with AI (1 AI credit). Search this chat, and Details (ⓘ): pinned messages, people, notifications (every message, or only @mentions), rename, Leave.

A message and its replies, kept apart from the main chat. Anyone who can see the chat can read and reply; the writer and everyone who replies are in the thread and get a notification for new replies. The chat shows the reply count under the message. On a wide screen it opens beside the chat.

What needs you from the last 30 days, newest first: someone @mentioned you, replied in a thread you're in, or reacted to your message. New ones have a dot; opening Activity marks them read. Tap one to open the chat at that message.

Threads you're part of (you wrote the message or replied in it), newest reply first, with how many replies and how many are new for you. A thread you only read isn't listed — reply in it to follow it.

Messages you saved for later (from a message's menu), with reminders: in 20 minutes, 1 or 3 hours, tonight, tomorrow morning or next week — a phone notification at that time; the ones due show first. ✓ marks one done.

Tasks made from Team messages: For me, I gave, Done. Make a task from any message's menu — what needs doing, who does it (anyone in the business; they get a notification), by when. ✨ Fill with AI reads the message and suggests all three (1 AI credit) — check it before making it. Tick to mark done; overdue ones are marked.

Searches every chat you can see in your business (or just one chat, from that chat's search): every word you type must be in the message. Filter: From (a person), With (photos, files, voice notes, links), Where. Tap a result to open the chat at that message.

A voice or video call in any chat — free for every business. 📞 voice, 🎥 video in the chat's header; a direct message rings the other person (a phone notification too), a channel shows 'call started' to its people; a green bar in the chat shows a call going on — tap to join. In the call: mute, camera on / off, switch camera and speaker (phones), Share your screen and Control a computer (with Office Pulse; screen sharing from a computer, the web app or Android), Leave. Everyone's camera or photo in a grid; a shared screen shows big; whoever speaks gets a green ring. When the call ends the chat shows '📞 Call · 12 min · who was in it' (or missed). Calls go through QTT's own server.

The business's files on QTT's own storage: Team files, My files, Company, HR, Shared with me, From HR. + New: upload, folder, document / sheet / presentation (edit together in the editor). ⋮ on a file: Share (people — view or edit; links for people outside with password, end date, limits, only listed emails, ask me first, preview only or upload only), Versions (30 days, restore), Lock, Tags, Comments, Activity, Folder access, Send to a chat, Rename, Delete (Recycle bin, 30 days). Files menu: Recycle bin, Requests, Activity here, Folder access, Audit log (owners and admins).

Who has this file or folder: people in the business (Can view / Can edit — remove anyone) and links for people outside (Make a link; each link: Change settings, New key — the old link stops at once, Who used it, Stop the link). Only those who may share it can change this.

A link for people outside: Preview only (look, no download or print — nothing stops a screenshot), Download, or Upload only on a folder (File Drop — they can't see what's there); a name only you see; a password (6+ characters, send it separately); ends after 1 hour, 1 day, 7 days, 30 days, never or on a date; how many opens / downloads; only these emails (they prove it with a code sent by email); Ask me first (you approve each person in Requests); Send the key separately. The link shows once — copy it then.

info.Where in the app: Files › ⋮ › Share › a link › Who used it
info.What it shows: Every open, download and upload through this link with the time and IP, wrong passwords or keys, and the people who asked to use it (pending, approved, declined).
The file now, and its older versions — one each time it was replaced or edited, kept 30 days. Restore makes an older one the file again (what it is now is kept as a version too).
What was deleted in the spaces you may change, kept 30 days (days left on each): Restore puts it back where it was; Delete for good can't be undone.

Waiting for you: people in the business asking to view or edit a file or folder, and people outside asking to open a link marked Ask me first — Approve or Decline (they're told). What you asked for, and what was decided.
Comments on a file; the people it's shared with and earlier commenters are told.
What happened to a file, or in a folder and everything in it: who uploaded, changed, viewed, downloaded, shared, locked, renamed, deleted or restored what, and when.
Owners and admins: everything done with the business's files in the last 30 days — who, what, when, and the IP for link visits.

Rules for a folder and everything in it, for everyone, a role or a person: Open, Change, Add, Delete, Share (none = no access). A person's rule beats a role's; a role beats everyone; owners and admins always have full access. Rules from folders above show as inherited.

Rules that act on files by themselves (owners and admins; HR for HR and Company): when a file is uploaded or tagged, in a space / folder, of some kinds, with any of some words in its name → add tags, move it (to a folder with {year} / {month}), tell people, share it. Start from a ready one (payslips, letters, ID proofs, invoices, contracts) or make your own; each shows how many times it acted.

info.Where in the app: Files › menu › Automatic rules › a rule
info.What it shows: One rule: its name and On; When (a file is uploaded, or tagged with a tag); Which files (space, folder and those inside it, kinds, words in the name); Then (add tags, move to a folder — {year} and {month} become the date it arrived, nothing is replaced, tell people, share it to view or edit). Remove deletes the rule; files it already acted on stay as they are.

The team calendar and your own events — a month with the chosen day's events under it. New event: times or all day, repeats, a phone reminder, Team calendar or only who you invite, where, a meeting link, notes, colour; invite people in the business (told on their phones) and outside by email (an invitation for their calendar, updates and cancellations). Show in another calendar: a private link for Google, Outlook or a phone.

One event: when, where, the meeting link, the organiser, Team calendar or private, notes; Yes / Maybe / No if you're invited (the organiser is told); who's invited and their answers. The organiser can Change or Delete it (everyone invited is told).

Title, all day, starts and ends, repeats (every day, weekday, week, month, year) until a date, reminder, Team calendar or Only who I invite, where, meeting link, notes, people in the business to invite, emails of people outside, colour.

People: everyone in the business with call, WhatsApp and email. Address book: customers, suppliers, partners and others (chips to choose), search, call / WhatsApp / email, + New contact. Menu: Import a .vcf (from a phone, Google or Outlook — no doubles) and Export as .vcf.

Your own mailbox in the app (it stays on your mail server; QTT keeps only the settings and the password, encrypted): folders with unread counts, search, messages as you scroll; Write. A message: Reply, Reply all, Forward, Mark as unread, Flag, Delete; attachments Download or Save to my files. Mailbox settings / Disconnect at the top.

Your email address (the server settings are filled in for Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, Zoho, iCloud and most hosting — change them under Server settings), the password or app password, your name on emails and a signature. Connect signs in to check before saving.
Who sent it, to whom, when, the text; Reply, Reply all, Forward (with its attachments), Mark as unread, Flag, Delete (to your Trash); attachments: Download or Save to my files.
To, Cc / Bcc, subject, message (a reply quotes the original; a forward carries its attachments), attach files up to 20 MB together; your signature is added. Send — a copy goes to your Sent folder.

Everything waiting for you: cards given to you on boards and Team tasks, by when they're due (Overdue, Today, Tomorrow, Later this week, Later, No date) — tick the circle to mark one done; today's calendar; team surveys to answer. Owners and admins: Team workload at the top right. A 9 AM 'Your day' on the phone when cards are due or overdue.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › My work › Team workload
info.What it shows: Each person's open cards, overdue cards, cards due this week and open Team tasks, with a bar — the most overdue first (owners and admins).
Your Kanban boards with their open and overdue cards. New board: start from To do, Project, Sales pipeline, Hiring, Content calendar or Customer issues.

The board's lists side by side. + adds a card to a list; long-press a card and drag it to another place or list (into the done list marks it done); tap to open it. Top right: Only my cards, a label, and ⋮ Lists, labels and people / Archive / Delete board (who made it, owners and admins).

Title and description (Save), its list, Done, a due date, people (told on their phones), labels, a checklist (tick items, add more), comments (the people on it are told); Archive or Delete at the top.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Boards › a board › Lists, labels and people
info.What it shows: The board's name and what it's for; lists (rename, add, drag to reorder, take away — its cards move to the first list); the list that means done; labels (tap the dot to change colour); Everyone in the business or Only the people I choose.
The business's knowledge and your own notes: search, chips for All / Pinned / Mine and each collection; + New note.

Reading: tap a checkbox to tick it; Change to write (Heading, List, Checkbox buttons; '- [ ] ' checkbox, '## ' heading, **bold**), a collection, who sees it (everyone, the people chosen, only me), Pin it to the top. ⋮ Send checkboxes to a board, Delete note. If someone else changed it meanwhile: Keep mine or Take theirs.

Drawing boards several people draw on at once. New whiteboard: a name, Everyone in the business can draw or only you. Opens in the app on phones, a browser tab on computers; saves as you draw. Save picture puts it in your Files › Whiteboards. ⋮ Rename or share, Delete.
The drawing: shapes, arrows, text, freehand; everyone's drawing joins in every few seconds. Save picture (top right) puts a picture in your Files › Whiteboards.
Team surveys waiting for your answer, and your forms with their answers. + New form: a public link for customers, or a team survey / poll in the app.

Title, what it's about, who answers (anyone with the link / my team in the app), questions (short answer, paragraph, one choice, several choices, dropdown, number, date, rating 1–5, yes / no, email, phone — a hint, Must be answered, move up / down), settings: taking answers, anonymous (team) or one answer each (public), an end date, phone alert per answer, add people who answer to the address book (as customer, supplier, partner, other), stop after N answers, a thank-you message.

The link (Copy, Send on WhatsApp); Summary — counts and bars per question, averages, the latest written answers; Answers — each one. ⋮ Change form, Download a spreadsheet, New link (the old one stops), Delete form.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Forms › a team survey
info.What it shows: A team survey's questions to answer and Send (once each). Anonymous surveys keep only that you answered, not your name.

info.What it shows: The WebDAV address and your user name (your email) to open Files as a drive on Windows, Mac, iPhone / iPad or an Android file app; sync passwords — New (one per computer or phone, shown once), Stop; how to connect on each. Same rights, locks, versions and recycle bin as the app.

A Word, Excel or PowerPoint file open in the editor (OnlyOffice, on QTT's own server). It saves as you type; others who open it at the same time edit with you and you see their cursors. On a phone it opens in the app; on a computer or the web app, in a new browser tab.

info.Where in the app: Team › Remote help (or Office Pulse › Remote help)
info.What it shows: With Office Pulse: see and control a computer as if you were sitting at it, through QTT's own server (RustDesk). Get help on this computer: 1 install RustDesk, 2 Copy server settings and import them in RustDesk (⋮ › Network › ID/Relay server), 3 Ask for help in a chat — your RustDesk ID (and its one-time password); the helper taps Connect on that message. Company computers: owners, admins and HR Admins add the business's computers (name, RustDesk ID, optional permanent password, who uses it) and connect in one tap, even when nobody is at the computer; others see the computers they use. Connect to an ID: type an ID someone reads out. From a call: Control a computer. The person at the computer sees it and can stop it any time.

A company computer. Set up automatically (recommended): Get the setup command, run it once on the computer (Windows: PowerShell as Administrator; Mac / Linux: Terminal with sudo; it works once, for an hour) — QTT locks RustDesk's settings and makes a password nobody sees, and changes it by itself when access is revoked (someone who used it leaves or loses owner / admin / HR Admin rights, the computer is reassigned, or Change password now); the page shows when the computer has checked in. Add by hand: name, RustDesk ID, permanent password — you change the password on the computer yourself when it's flagged. Remove: a computer set up automatically is locked with a password nobody knows.

HR: each employee's folder of documents (offer letter, ID proofs, contracts, letters). Pick a person → their folder (HR › People › name); upload or make documents there. The employee sees only their own folder, read-only, in Files › From HR.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › My attendance › Request work from home / on duty
info.What it shows: Ask to work from home or be marked on duty for one or more days: choose which, the dates, and a line of detail; your approver decides.
Your payslips, newest first: earnings, deductions, net pay; download the PDF. They appear after HR runs and finalises payroll.
One month's payslip: the period and days paid out of working days, net pay (also in words), each earning with gross pay, each deduction with the total, and Download PDF.
Who is in, out, on leave or not in yet today (remote check-ins are marked).

Requests waiting at a step you approve — leave, work from home / on duty, expenses, late check-ins, missed check-outs, shift changes and swaps, early exits, overtime. Filter chips by kind (Leave, Expenses, Attendance, Shifts, Check-in & out), each kind with its own icon and colour on its cards; leave cards show the balance left and, with Coverage, a warning when approving would leave a shift short. A swap partner sees Accept / Decline first.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › People › a person
info.What it shows: One person: Details (Edit), Give app access (an email invitation; when they accept, their login is linked to them — or they already have one), Attendance (and Mark attendance for a day), Shifts (the next two weeks, change one day), Salary (HR Admin), Mark as left (on a date; their Office Pulse access is removed, records kept).

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › People › a person › Shifts
info.What it shows: The person's next two weeks, day by day (shift, place, Holiday, Off). Tap a day to give a different shift, place or a day off — only that day changes and they're told; the days around it keep theirs, and editing the shift pattern later never undoes it. Back to the pattern undoes the one-day change.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › People › Add / Edit
info.What it shows: An employee's details: first and last name, gender and date of birth (required), joining date (empty = today), mobile, email, department, job title, reports to (their manager — approves their requests and sees them in Team), Device PIN (their user ID on biometric devices). Add new creates a department or job title on the spot.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › People › a person › Salary
info.What it shows: The person's salary history (template, monthly salary, from date, newest first) and Set salary with a template from a date. A raise = set it again from the new date; the history keeps the old one. Needs an active salary template (Payroll › Salary templates).

Employees (working / left): add, edit, give app access (email invitation), mark attendance, salary, mark as left. On top: action cards — import the team from Excel, invite everyone with an email in one tap, download people missing a mobile or department to fix them in Excel — and Import / Export (Excel or CSV) buttons.

Import employees from Excel (.xlsx) or CSV (up to 1,000): a template to download; columns recognised by name (also misspelt, else suggested by QTT Assistant) and changeable; each row checked — new, update (matched by employee ID, email or mobile) or a problem with the reason; suggestions (new departments, missing mobiles, plan room); optional app invitations; large files continue in the background. QTT can import it for you.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Biometric devices › a device
info.What it shows: One device: its name, In / out (From the device — people press Check-in / Check-out; or By the shift rules — they just punch and Office Pulse works out in and out), a clock correction in minutes (only if its clock is wrong), Accept punches from this device (off: the device keeps its punches and sends them again when switched back on), Save, Get missed punches (the last 7 days again, duplicates skipped), Remove this device (its punches stop coming in; those already here stay), and the latest punches with what became of each: Saved, Waiting (a PIN not linked to anyone yet), Already in (a duplicate, or pressed again within moments) or Problem (the reason is shown).

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Biometric devices › Add device
info.What it shows: Add a biometric device by its serial number (on the label underneath, or Menu › System info), an optional name, and In / out — From the device (people press Check-in / Check-out) or By the shift rules (they just punch). Set the device to the server address first; it's accepted as soon as it's added here and sends the punches it's holding.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Biometric devices
info.What it shows: Fingerprint / face devices (ZKTeco, eSSL and others with ADMS or 'Cloud server') that send punches to Office Pulse by themselves: add a device by its serial number, see if it's online and its last punch, link each PIN on the device to a person (names from the device are suggested), ask a device to send missed punches again, see each punch and what became of it.

Check-in rules (ask for location; allow check-in away from the office), offices and their check-in radius, business type and capabilities, sites, biometric devices, shifts (hours, late after, break, split), shift patterns, approval flows, attendance rules, leave types and giving leave, holiday calendars, departments and job titles.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Performance, hiring and training
info.What it shows: Performance: appraisal cycles, key result areas (KRAs) and appraisals with scores. Recruitment: job openings, applicants, interview rounds and interviews. Training: programmes, training sessions, skills and each employee's skill map. Reports: appraisal overview and recruitment analytics. Training comes with the Standard plan; appraisal and recruitment with Business — the rest show as locked.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Start here
info.What it shows: The set-up guide: steps in order — Do these first (business type, team, holidays, shifts, who works which shift, check-in places, the app for the team), Then (leave for the year; payroll: template, salaries, monthly run — HR Admin), Optional (approvals, attendance rules, departments, devices, sites, coverage, overtime). Each step says why, shows if it's done from the business's own data (e.g. "12 of 16 people have a shift"), and opens its screen; Next shows the one to do now; How it fits together explains shifts vs assigning vs patterns vs one-day changes, holidays, leave and payroll. Who can do what lists each Office Pulse role (Employee, HR, HR Admin) with what it can and can't use in this business.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Check-in rules
info.What it shows: Ask for location when checking in (on / off); allow check-in away from the office (they add a reason and it shows as remote); offices: stand at the office and tap “Add this place as an office” (the phone finds the place, then you name it), set how far away check-in works (50–1000 m) with the slider, remove an office (asks first). Nothing changes until you tap Save; leaving with unsaved changes asks first. With no offices, check-in works from anywhere.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Leave types
info.What it shows: Leave types (name, most days a year or unpaid, unused days carry over); Give leave on a type: one page with the year, days for each person and who (each person shows if they already have it and how much they've used; people without it are chosen to start; optionally change people who already have it), then a summary by name — given, changed, already had it, or couldn't and why; and Leave for past days — how far back leave may start (0 = today onward, up to 90 days; the server checks it too).

Holiday calendars: each has named holidays and one or more week-off days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday). The whole company uses one; a team (department) or a person can use another — their own beats their team's, which beats the company's. Assign a calendar: Whole company / Teams / People, pick the calendar, tick who, then Use; or put them back to the usual. New calendar: name, year, week-off days, optionally copy another calendar's holidays. In a calendar: change week-off days (Save week-off days, whole year), add or remove holidays, use it for the whole company. Leave days, attendance, automatic attendance, shifts, coverage and Team today follow each person's calendar.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Departments and job titles
info.What it shows: Add departments and job titles, with how many people are in each. They're chosen on each employee's profile (People › Add / Edit employee).

Places your people work at (needs the Sites capability in Business type): name, address, check-in area (tap while standing at the site — the phone finds the place), radius in metres, notes for people working there, in use or not.

The business's salary templates and how many people are on each; New salary template. A template splits a monthly salary into pay items (earnings and deductions); one template fits everyone in a kind of job — each person's own monthly salary is entered when it's given to them.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Payroll › Salary templates › a template
info.What it shows: One template: name, its pay items with an amount or a formula ("base" = the person's monthly salary; earlier items by short code, e.g. BS * 0.4), Save draft, Start using (after that it can't be edited — Make a copy to change it — and it can be given to people), Give to people (from a date, with the monthly salary).

The pay items salary templates use: name, Earning or Deduction, short code (used in formulas, e.g. BS), and a default amount or formula. The starter ones: Basic Salary (BS = base * 0.5), House Rent Allowance (HRA = BS * 0.4), Special Allowance (SA = base - BS - HRA).

One month's payroll: the checks to look at first (punches not in attendance, punches waiting for a person, undecided requests, approved overtime, quiet devices), each person's salary slip with days paid, gross pay, deductions and net pay, overtime and on-call added, Refresh, and Finalise and publish payslips (employees then see them and the salary entry is posted to the accounts).
Steps: 1) a salary template with pay items (formulas allowed, e.g. base * 0.4), 2) give it to people with their monthly salary, 3) run payroll for a month, check, then finalise and publish payslips.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Business type
info.What it shows: Pick the kind of business (office, security, hospital, factory, retail). Its preset switches on the capabilities it usually needs — Flexible cycles, Sites, Requests, Split shifts, Overtime pay, Coverage (with handover and on-call), Offline attendance — and suggested attendance rules. Everything can be changed afterwards.

Working hours: start, end (an end before the start means the next day), late after minutes, automatic attendance, a break rule (unpaid minutes after hours worked, or paid), and — with Split shifts — time off in the middle.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Shift patterns › a pattern
info.What it shows: One shift pattern: its name; how it repeats — by week (the same every week, or a rotation of 2–4 weeks; up to 8 with Flexible cycles) or, with Flexible cycles, by day (every 2–56 days, e.g. 4 on / 4 off = 8); each day's shift or Day off, where (office, from home, anywhere, or a site with Sites); Who — everyone, a department or chosen people, with a live list of who joins, who stays on another pattern and why, and who leaves; Save and apply (gives shifts 60 days ahead); Stop using this pattern (its people move to the next pattern that fits them, or keep the shifts given under Shifts).

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Shift patterns
info.What it shows: Which shift on which day, and where (office, from home, anywhere or a site): the same every week, a rotation of up to 4 weeks (8 with Flexible cycles), or (Flexible cycles) every N days like 4 on / 4 off. Applies to everyone, a department or chosen people; gives shifts 60 days ahead. One-day changes in People are kept.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Attendance rules
info.What it shows: Late check-ins needing approval (after N minutes; if not approved: half day, absent or late mark), check-out required with reminders and what happens without one, how long a forgotten check-out stays open, early exits and overtime needing approval, how long offline check-ins are accepted, and the morning coverage alert.

Your shift changes, shift swaps, early exits, overtime, late check-ins and missed check-outs, with who each is waiting for. New request (when the business uses Requests): another shift / place / day off, a swap with a colleague (they accept first), leaving early, or overtime.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Approval flows › a kind of request
info.What it shows: One kind of request's steps, in order (up to 5): Approved by — manager or HR, manager, manager's manager, HR, HR Admin or a chosen person; Only when — always, or only above a number in the kind's own unit (leave / work from home: days; expense: amount; late check-in, early exit, overtime: minutes; missed check-out and shift requests: always) — smaller requests skip that step; Add HR after N hours — if nobody decides the step in time HR can decide it too (checked hourly, up to 168); Save (leaving with changes asks: Save, Discard or Keep editing); Use the default — removes the steps (manager or HR).

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Setup › Approval flows
info.What it shows: Per kind of request (leave, work from home, expense, late check-in, missed check-out, shift change, swap, early exit, overtime): up to 5 steps — manager, manager's manager, HR, HR Admin or a chosen person — each optionally only above an amount, days or minutes, with HR added after N hours waiting. "Only when" fits the kind: days for leave and work from home, an amount for expenses, minutes for late check-in, early exit and overtime; missed check-out and shift requests always. No steps: the manager or HR.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › Payroll › Overtime and on-call pay
info.What it shows: How approved overtime and on-call days are paid in payroll runs (Overtime pay capability): hourly rate (monthly base ÷ days ÷ hours, or a fixed rate), multiplier, counting in blocks of minutes, on-call allowance per day. Each is paid once; HR sees what's added before slips are made.

Coverage capability: rules for the fewest people a shift (at a site, on chosen weekdays) needs; the next 2 weeks with gaps; a 07:00 alert to HR for the next 3 days; warnings on approvals when leave or a shift change would leave a shift short. Handover notes from the end of a shift show on the next shift's check-in card.

info.Where in the app: Office Pulse › Manage › On call › Add
info.What it shows: Put someone on call for some days, or a rotation: the people take turns in the order you tick them, each for Days each, going round the list Times round. A note is optional. On call now shows on Team today and the person's check-in card; paid per day when HR Admin sets an on-call allowance.

Coverage capability: who is on call now and next; add one person for some days, or a rotation where chosen people take turns (days each, times round). On call now shows on Team today and the person's check-in card; paid per day when HR Admin sets an on-call allowance.

info.What it shows: Today's sales, money to collect, items running low, and your tiles.

Quick counter sale: tap items (search or barcode), choose a customer or walk-in, take payment (cash, UPI, card, or split; change is worked out), save the bill PDF. With no network, finish the sale as usual: it is saved on this device and sent when the network is back (Send now sends it at once); a sale the server refuses shows with its time and amount to enter again.
Invoices (unpaid first) and quotes: new invoice, new quote, receive a payment, save or share the PDF, take back items (credit note), turn a quote into an invoice.
Bill a customer: items, GST, total, paid now or later.
Items and services: price, cost, GST rate, HSN/SAC, barcode, low-stock level; add stock, count stock, move between stores; running-low list.
Supplier bills (stock comes in), what you still owe, suppliers, pay a supplier. Needs a plan with Purchases.
The business's one customer list (search, Active / Archived, tags — the same list the Inbox uses); a customer shows who owes you and what they bought, New invoice, Receive payment and Edit details.
Money in and out, record shop expenses (rent, electricity…), move money between cash and bank, who owes you and whom you owe. Needs a plan with Accounts.
For a period: sales by day, best sellers, best customers, GST (collected minus paid on purchases), profit, stock value. Needs a plan with Reports.
Selling prices include GST (on/off), main store, invoice note, run setup again. Business details on invoices come from Business › Profile.
The business's stores and godowns: add one (your plan sets how many), see each store's stock, move stock between them. POS and new bills sell from the main store (Orbitra settings).

The full ERP, by group: Sales (sales orders → delivery notes → invoices, price lists, item prices, pricing rules), Buying (purchase orders → goods receipts → bills, requests for quotation, supplier quotations, scorecards), Stock (reorder levels, batches, serial numbers, pick lists, packing slips, landed cost), Accounts (cost centres, budgets, assets, bank reconciliation), CRM (leads, opportunities, quotations, territories, sales partners, loyalty, customer portal), Manufacturing (bills of materials, work orders, job cards, workstations, operations, production plans, subcontracting, stock entries), Quality (inspections and templates, goals, non-conformance, procedures) and Maintenance (teams, schedules, visits, repairs); reports: trial balance, balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow, budget variance, stock ledger, batch expiry, sales funnel, supplier quotation comparison, work order and quality inspection summaries. Each list has search and a Draft / Submitted / Cancelled filter; a draft can be changed, then submitted; a submitted document can be cancelled; the next document (delivery note, bill, return, landed cost…) is one tap and comes filled in. What you see follows your role and the plan: Standard adds sales flow, stock depth and CRM; Business adds accounts depth and manufacturing — groups in a bigger plan show as locked.

Orbitra's set-up guide (Orbitra Admin): Do these first — business details (address, logo; GSTIN if registered), Orbitra settings (prices include GST or not, main store), add items, add opening stock, make your first bill at POS; Then — invite the team, choose what each role can do, add customers you give credit to; Optional — supplier bills, more stores, reports. Each step is ticked from the business's own data with a count (e.g. "42 items"). Who can do what lists each role (Cashier, Manager, Orbitra Admin) with what it can and can't use in this business.

info.What it shows: Your real screenshots (1–3) and a few words become several posters, each a different design: your headline, main points and button words; under More a number and what it counts, chips, steps, problems and Before / After labels. Each screenshot's label chooses which part shows: Top, Middle, Bottom or Whole screen (all of it, on a soft blurred copy — nothing cut); a small screenshot is enlarged so it stays sharp. Keep the screen clear puts the points beside the phone, never over your screen. Designs include Website on a laptop, On a tablet and Before and after (two screenshots). Choose designs or let Studio pick (a design needing a number, steps, chips or two screens is offered only when you gave them), how many (2–8), the size (Square, Portrait, Story, Wide 16:9, Landscape 3:2) and colours (your brand, colours that suit your screenshot, or a colour set). Your screen is shown exactly as it is; nothing you didn't give is added. AI words for each poster: 1 credit. Each poster counts as a design. Another like this; open one to change it, Every size, Post it, Your screen (which part shows, Keep the screen clear — free); AI background on In context, Floating chips and Open book (10 credits).

QTT Studio makes what your business needs, in your logo, colours and fonts, written from your Business knowledge. What do you need today?: type it or tap a quick choice (Festival wish, Offer, New product, We're hiring, Thank you) and Make it — AI picks a design and writes it (1 AI credit), then Made for you shows it with Use it, Change it and Show me another one. Copy the style of a poster you like (3 AI credits; the poster is never copied). A festival in the next 3 weeks shows with Make your wish post (no AI). Big buttons by what you want: Posts for social media (Choose a template), Make my photos look pro (Photo Lab), Short video from photos (Shorts), Cards, flyers and menus (Print), Logo and brand, Letters and documents, One-page website (Pages), Posters of my app or website (Poster variations). Your work (everything made; See all), Your brand. Plans: Studio Starter, Growth and Pro, 14-day free trial in Explore QTT OS. Without Studio, the designs QTT already made stay free (Marketing assistant › Post designs).

One design (Your design): its picture; Edit your design opens the editor; Use it — Post it (a Marketing assistant post waiting for your OK), WhatsApp, Download, Print (a PDF to print), Another (the same words in another design; one asked for in words is asked again, 1 AI credit). Tabs: Words (quick edit: the small line above, the headline with *word* in colour, the line below, the button, the badge — Save), Ask AI (quick choices or your own words, 1 AI credit), Size (Square, Portrait, Story; Every size at once), Colours (Light, Dark, Your colour), Photo (add one of your photos). The editor: tap anything to drag it, pull a corner, turn it; words — font, size, colour, bold, italic, align, effects (shadow, lift, glow, outline, box behind); photos — replace, crop, filters, adjust (brightness, contrast, colour, blur, see-through), remove background, flip, frame; badges, shapes and icons — colour; any piece — layer (forward, backward, all layers), copy, delete. Add: Text (heading, subheading, a line), Photos (your photos, Library pictures, your logo), Elements (badges, shapes and lines, icons), Background (a colour, or the design's own), Brand (logo, your colours and fonts), Layers (drag to put in front or behind, hide, lock). Undo and redo; Size; Done draws the picture exactly as edited. Works in the phone app and the web app. Delete removes the design.

Change the words, sections, button (WhatsApp, call or a link), photos (your own), the offer (only a real one), event details and search words; Preview on a private link, then Publish (Growth 1 live page, Pro 5). Views are counted.

A 9:16 video for Reels, YouTube Shorts and WhatsApp Status from up to 4 of your own photos (in order): a hook, a caption on each photo with a slow zoom, and an end card with your logo, phone and website. Type the words or Ask AI to write them (2 AI credits). Make the Short — it is made in the background in about a minute; then Play the video, Post it (waits for your OK in the Marketing assistant) or Delete. Add music in the app you post to.

Visiting cards (front and back), flyers (A5, A4) and menus / price lists (A4) in your logo, colours and fonts. Show the styles › pick one › Make print files: a print-ready PDF with 3 mm bleed and crop marks for the print shop, and a picture of each side to share. Saved under Your print designs.

Logo ideas from your business name, tagline and an icon, in your own colours and fonts — monograms, wordmarks, icon and name, emblems, stacked (Show logo ideas). AI logo symbol: say what it should show and AI draws two symbols, your name set beside them in your font so it is always spelt right (20 AI credits). Tap one › Save this logo: SVG, PNG, PDF, square icons and a favicon in one zip. A saved logo › Use as my logo (owner and admins): posts, brand kit and every PDF use it.

How every PDF you print looks — invoices, quotations, challans, receipts, payslips, letters, ID cards. Four letterhead styles shown with your own logo, colour and details: QTT dark band (free), Clean, Your colour, Classic letterhead; tap one to use it for every document (owner and admins; the others need Studio).
